---
# ============================================================================
# FigA2.qmd
#
# Produces Appendix Figure A2: Cell Tower Locations in Afghanistan.
#   NOTE: Uses synthetic tower coordinates — output is not meaningful.
#   The confidential antenna geolocation file cannot be shared.
#
# Input:  Data/figures_data/country_shp/gadm36_AFG_0.shp
#         Data/figures_data/district_shp/district398.shp
#         Data/figures_data/synthetic/cell_lookup_antenna_synthetic.csv
# Output: Output/Figures/FigA2_cell_towers_in_afg.pdf
#
# Required packages: tidyverse, sf, this.path
# To install:  install.packages(c("tidyverse", "sf", "this.path"))
#
# USAGE: Update maindir in the setup chunk to the root of your local copy
#        of the replication package before running.
# ============================================================================
---

# Tower Locations {.unnumbered}

```{r setup, include = FALSE}

rm(list = ls())

# Load Packages
if (!require(pacman)) install.packages('pacman', repos = 'https://cran.rstudio.com')
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, haven, data.table, sf, lubridate, stars, this.path, geosphere, fastcluster, kableExtra, ncmeta)

# Setting directory
maindir <- "<PATH_TO_REPLICATION_PACKAGE>" 

# File Paths
paths = list(
  'shp_cntry' = file.path(maindir, 'Data/figures_data/country_shp/gadm36_AFG_0.shp'),
  'shp_districts' = file.path(maindir, 'Data/figures_data/district_shp/district398.shp'),
  'tower_file' = file.path(maindir, 'Data/figures_data/synthetic/cell_lookup_antenna_synthetic.csv')
)

crs_unproj = 4326
crs_proj = 24313

```

```{r, include=FALSE}

#-----------------------------  Country Boundary -----------------------------#

# Get Afghanistan country boundary
geodf_cntry = read_sf(paths[['shp_cntry']]) |>
  st_transform(crs_proj)

#----------------------------   District Geometry    -------------------------#

# Get Afghanistan districts
geodf_districts = read_sf(paths[['shp_districts']]) |>
  st_transform(crs_proj) |>
  # tidy columns
  rename(provinceName = PROV_34_NA,
         districtName = DIST_34_NA,
         distid = DISTID,
         provid = PROVID) |>
  dplyr::select(-OBJECTID)

```

```{r, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

# 1739 towers
geodf_tower = read_csv(paths$tower_file) |>
  rename(lng_tower = longitude,
         lat_tower = latitude) |>
  st_as_sf(coords = c('lng_tower','lat_tower'), crs = crs_unproj, remove = F) |>
  st_transform(crs_proj)

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = geodf_tower, colour = 'midnightblue', size = 1, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_sf(data = geodf_districts, fill = NA, colour = 'gray80', size = 0.2) +
  geom_sf(data = geodf_cntry, fill = NA, colour = 'black', size = 1) +
  theme_minimal() 

ggsave(filename = file.path(maindir, 'Output/Figures/FigA2_cell_towers_in_afg.pdf'),
       plot = last_plot())
  
```
